claims.claim: Assisted performance, unassisted performance, delayed retention and transfer are distinct outcomes; current fluency can mislead learning judgments.
claims.verified: Retrieved official research overview; no new experimental effect claimed.

claims.claim: Bastani et al.: GPT Base practice grades +48% relative to control; subsequent unassisted exam grades -17%. Nearly 1,000 high-school students in Turkey.
claims.verified: Publisher indexed full text and author PDF located; relative changes, not percentage points.

claims.claim: GPT Tutor largely mitigated the unassisted-exam penalty; its exam performance was not statistically distinguishable from control.
claims.verified: Publisher indexed results; do not label this a positive exam gain.

claims.claim: Kestin et al.: a structured AI tutor improved an immediate college physics post-test relative to active classroom instruction.
claims.verified: Publisher PDF full text retrieved. Pages 2, 4–5 and 7 verify post-lesson testing, sequential scaffolding, instructor-authored prompts and feedback. No numeric effect in narration.

claims.claim: Offloading delegates cognitive work to an external tool; whether it helps learning depends on the target process and task.
claims.verified: Fresh author abstract and manuscript record retrieved from UCL. Practical learning advice is editorial synthesis, not an effect size from this review.

claims.claim: Worked examples can help novices; no universal superiority of withholding answers is established here.
claims.verified: Publisher indexed full text retrieved, including randomized Year-7 novice experiment, retention and near-transfer outcomes. No effect size used.

claims.claim: Retrieval practice benefits depend on the comparator and corrective feedback; recall is not uniformly superior.
claims.verified: Fresh publisher abstract retrieved: 44 studies, 142 comparisons; benefits depend on feedback and comparator. No numeric effect used.
